feature: hobin-feature Stop hook: session ledger and safe record discovery
request: Fix the hobin-feature Stop hook at the root. P1: record discovery follows symbolic links and crashes on ENOENT/ELOOP. P2: a checker crash and an incomplete record both exit 2. P3: the hook checks every record under the cwd tree, not only the session's. P4: mtime attribution treats another session's writes as this session's. P5: scenarios.mjs run without a path runs the whole tree. Decisions: D1 attribute records with a ledger filled by Pre/PostToolUse and check only ledger records on Stop; D2 leave the sibling hook-input.mjs hooks to a separate PR; D3 keep the no-argument behavior of scenarios.mjs and make the skill pass the record path.

condition_table.note: Ledger attribution (PostToolUse unless stated). Stamp = time PreToolUse(Bash) saw the same call, keyed by tool_use_id; a call without tool_use_id gets no stamp, and a stamp that is not a positive time no later than now is no stamp. Session start = transcript creation time.
rows: edit tool (Write/Edit/MultiEdit, apply_patch Add/Update/Move to) on a record name -> ledger += path (F10); NotebookEdit is not watched: it edits .ipynb, never a .json record
edit tool on any other name, or apply_patch Delete File -> nothing (F10)
Bash, command names no record file and no record script -> nothing, no walk (F15)
Bash, command names a record or script, stamp present -> record paths in the command and records under the call's cwd changed since stamp - 1s -> ledger (F7, F8, F9)
Bash that failed (Claude delivers PostToolUseFailure, not PostToolUse) -> the same rules as a successful command (F20)

a shell command's candidate record that git tracks, still holds as committed, and last committed before the call -> written by a checkout, a worktree, a pull: not the command's (F23); git words in the command text change nothing, a record written in the same command as a checkout counts (F24), and a record the command wrote and committed counts (F25); a record in a git-ignored folder counts (F26)
Bash, stamp unreadable or empty, or call without tool_use_id -> treated as stamp missing (F22)
Bash, command names a record or script, stamp missing -> only record paths named in the command and changed since session start; no walk (F17)
Stop: ledger path no longer exists -> dropped, exit 0 when nothing else is left (F21)
Stop: record is not JSON -> record problem, exit 2 (F11); checker throws -> internal error, exit 1, never 2 (F12)

decisions.question: How does the Stop hook decide which records belong to this session?
decisions.decision: A per-session ledger filled by PreToolUse/PostToolUse hooks; Stop checks only ledger records and never walks the tree
decisions.reason: mtime attribution checked other sessions' records (701 records under a parent folder) and walked large trees on every stop
decisions.revert: Restore the mtime walk in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs, drop the PreToolUse/PostToolUse entries from both hooks.json files, and update F5, F6, F15

decisions.question: Do the sibling hooks sharing hook-input.mjs (review, stances, learning) change in this PR?
decisions.reason: Keep this change to one plugin and its guarantees
decisions.revert: Not applicable; the follow-up PR applies the same walker to hook-input.mjs

decisions.question: What does scenarios.mjs run/check do without a path?
decisions.decision: Unchanged (every record under the cwd); the skill now passes the record path
decisions.reason: Existing users rely on the no-argument form; a refusal would break them
decisions.revert: Make the no-argument form refuse more than one record and update F19

decisions.question: What does Stop do when a checker throws (not a record problem)?
decisions.decision: Exit 1 with a message naming it an internal error: visible to the user, never blocking the model
decisions.reason: A hook must not send the model back for the hook's own failure; exit 0 would hide it
decisions.revert: Change the exit code in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs and F12

decisions.question: Which root does a record get checked against?
decisions.decision: The hook root when it lies inside a git work tree and contains the record (unchanged behavior); otherwise the record's nearest ancestor holding .git; otherwise the hook root
decisions.reason: Keeps every in-repository session exactly as before and fixes the parent-folder case
decisions.revert: Always use the hook root in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs and drop F14

decisions.question: What counts for a shell command without a usable stamp (no PreToolUse, no tool_use_id, or an unreadable stamp)?
decisions.decision: Only record paths named in the command and changed since the session started; no walk
decisions.reason: Without a trustworthy start time a walk cannot tell this call's writes from anyone else's; a shared or empty stamp would claim every record under the cwd
decisions.revert: Change readStamp and the fallback in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs and F17, F22

decisions.question: Do record discovery walks follow symbolic links?
decisions.decision: No; symlinked directories and files are skipped, and an unreadable entry is skipped
decisions.reason: Following links is what crashed (ENOENT, ELOOP); a record behind a link is still checked when named by path
decisions.revert: Follow links with a visited-realpath set in core/developing-features/scripts/records.mjs

decisions.question: Where does the ledger live, and what happens if it is lost?
decisions.decision: Append-only file per session_id in the hook process's own temp directory, written only by the hook; losing it (reboot, cleanup) only means the hook stops enforcing for that session
decisions.reason: Appends are safe across parallel tool calls; losing the ledger fails open, never blocking unrelated work
decisions.revert: Move the ledger path in scenarios-stop-hook.mjs

decisions.question: What should a record show while scenarios.mjs run is in progress or after it was killed?
decisions.decision: Mark every result running and write verification.run {startedAt, lastProgressAt} first, save after each scenario and the existing tests, delete verification.run when the run ends (also on a throw); check and Stop treat a present verification.run as incomplete and say: wait if still running, run again if stopped; no liveness claim
decisions.reason: An interrupted run must never leave earlier passes that check accepts (G6); state in the record needs no temp directory shared with the hook, and a pid check could not be trusted across machines or pid reuse
decisions.revert: Restore the single write at the end of run

decisions.question: Should run accept an --only list of scenario ids?
decisions.reason: A partial run cannot show the other scenarios still pass after a code change (G5 last run)
decisions.revert: Add --only together with a code fingerprint per result

decisions.question: How does the hook know a record is the session's, wherever it lives?
decisions.decision: The record tools print a hobin-feature-record line with the absolute path (decline prints a hobin-feature-decline line with the reason); the hook reads every string of every tool's output (PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure) and registers absolute, existing record paths in its own ledger; edit tools register their exact path; no session environment, no shared temp directory, no shell text or tree inference
decisions.reason: Directory inference measured 2.7 s and 4.6 s with 743 false records and still misses computed paths; the session-id-plus-shared-TMPDIR revision depended on host environment details the plugin does not own. The user asked for that assumption to be removed, not documented
decisions.revert: Restore registration from CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID / CODEX_THREAD_ID in records.mjs and the scripts, and the env strip in scenarios.mjs run

decisions.question: When must the session produce a record?
decisions.decision: Once developing-features starts by a fixed identifier (Claude Skill tool / slash prompt, Codex $mention / SKILL.md read); released only by a registered record or decline --reason
decisions.reason: A record written outside the tools would otherwise silently escape the gate
decisions.revert: Drop the obligation branch in stop() and the UserPromptSubmit/Skill hooks

decisions.question: Does a decline exempt records already registered?
decisions.decision: No; it lifts only the 'no record yet' obligation
decisions.reason: Conservative: a registered record that fails is still unverified work
decisions.revert: Skip checkRecords when a decline exists

decisions.question: What about a record touched only by a background run, whose output the hook never sees?
decisions.decision: Not registered; the Stop message and SKILL.md step 1 ask for a foreground scenarios.mjs check with the record path (or init, or decline)
decisions.reason: Deterministic recovery without sharing state with the command; the block is visible, never a silent pass
decisions.revert: Not applicable without shared state between the hook and the command

decisions.question: Does a marker inside a file the session reads (Read tool, cat) register the record?
decisions.decision: Yes, when the path is absolute, exists and names a record
decisions.reason: Fail-safe: the worst case is an extra record the session must make pass, never a record silently left ungated
decisions.revert: Limit marker parsing to shell tool responses in printedMarkers
